title: Survey of Bias In Text-to-Image Generation: Definition, Evaluation, and Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing human annotation, automated classifiers (e.g., FairFace, CLIP), VQA models, and embedding distance metrics to assess gender distributions in default generations, occupational associations, power dynamics, and image quality.

Surveying evaluation methods including VQA models, automated classifiers mapping to skin tone scales (e.g., Monk Skin Tone, ITA), and embedding distances to measure representational parity and biased associations with occupations and characteristics.

Analyzing techniques such as CLIP embedding proximity to culturally-explicit texts, human annotation for geographical representativeness, and VQA models to assess the over-representation of Western norms and specific cultural stereotypes.
